answer: An identity commits to the hash of a finished task, reveals the payload next round, and the receipt is split across three independent auditors who each redo the check without seeing the others' notes, so no single auditor can be bought for the whole verdict. The claim then gets re-checked by an agent with nothing to gain from it. On a mesa of identical clones the reveals arrive with identical payloads and the auditors catch it at once. The hollow part is that a patient operator can still spread clones across separate islands and pass one at a time.
